definitions: A temple dedicated to all the gods of a particular religion or culture.
A building in Rome, Italy, originally a temple to all gods, later a Christian church, and now a tomb for famous Italians.
The group of all the gods of a polytheistic religion or mythology.
examples: The Roman Pantheon is an architectural marvel.
The Pantheon of Greek gods includes Zeus, Hera, and Poseidon.
Many famous figures are interred in the Pantheon in Paris.
